name: doctor
description: Probe available backends, current policy, session and remediation instructions.

name: capabilities.list
description: Return capabilities granted to this session, not merely installed APIs.

name: commands.search
description: Search the shared typed command registry.

name: commands.describe
description: Describe input/output schemas, risk and backend candidates.

name: audit.tail
description: Return recent metadata-only audit records.

name: plugin.list
description: List configured, digest-pinned plugins and sandbox status.

name: plugin.describe
description: Describe a configured plugin manifest.

name: recipe.list
description: List example recipes available in the repository.

name: recipe.validate
description: Validate a versioned declarative recipe without executing it.

name: recipe.run
description: Execute a validated recipe; each step re-enters the broker.

name: app.list
description: Enumerate accessible applications; incomplete accessibility is reported.

name: app.launch
description: Launch only an administrator-configured application key, never arbitrary argv.

name: app.close
description: Close a referenced application window with external confirmation.

name: window.list
description: List compositor-native windows with opaque session references.

name: window.focus
description: Focus the exact referenced window.

name: window.move
description: Move a referenced window in logical compositor coordinates.

name: window.resize
description: Resize a referenced window in logical compositor coordinates.

name: window.close
description: Request application close; unsaved work may be lost.

name: ui.snapshot
description: Bounded semantic accessibility snapshot with conservative revision deltas. No screenshot or OCR.

name: ui.find
description: Exact or ranked discovery. Ambiguous matches are returned, never auto-invoked.

name: ui.invoke
description: Invoke an advertised accessibility Action on an exact live reference.

name: ui.set_text
description: Set editable text through AT-SPI, not through keyboard emulation.

name: ui.read_text
description: Read non-password accessible text with explicit permission.

name: ui.set_value
description: Set an accessible numeric value within the host-reported range.

name: ui.get_value
description: Read the accessible numeric value and range.

name: ui.toggle
description: Invoke an explicitly advertised toggle action.

name: ui.select
description: Select a child through the AT-SPI Selection interface.

name: ui.expand
description: Invoke an explicitly advertised expand action.

name: portal.start
description: Request a RemoteDesktop session with native consent; persistence and portal clipboard access are explicit opt-ins.

persist_mode.description: 0 ephemeral, 1 process lifetime, 2 persist until desktop permission is revoked

clipboard.description: Request Clipboard portal integration for this RemoteDesktop session

name: portal.stop
description: Revoke and close this broker RemoteDesktop session.

name: portal.status
description: Inspect portal consent/session state, interface versions and restore-token availability without exposing token material.

name: portal.restore.clear
description: Forget process-local and durable RemoteDesktop restore tokens without claiming to revoke the desktop portal permission itself.

name: input.key
description: Send a keysym through an explicitly enabled input backend with focus precondition.

name: input.type
description: Type Unicode using a consented portal or focused X11; semantic set_text is preferred.

name: pointer.move
description: Move pointer relative to its current location (logical delta), guarded by expected focus.

name: pointer.click
description: Click the current pointer position; requires an explicit live window reference.

name: pointer.scroll
description: Scroll through the approved pointer backend; no raw coordinate fallback.

name: screen.capture
description: Request an interactive screenshot and copy it to a private expiring artifact.

name: screen.stream_info
description: Describe ScreenCast support and the owner session's active PipeWire streams.

name: screen.stream.start
description: Request a user-consented ScreenCast session for bounded PipeWire frame capture.

name: screen.stream.capture
description: Capture one bounded frame from an active owner ScreenCast stream into a private PNG artifact.

name: screen.stream.stop
description: Revoke and close this broker session's active ScreenCast grant.

name: clipboard.read
description: Read clipboard text only when explicitly granted; never audit its contents.

name: clipboard.write
description: Set clipboard text using an explicit backend, without shell interpolation.

name: process.list
description: List current-user process metadata without command lines or environment variables.

name: process.signal
description: Signal only a process launched and retained by this broker.

name: filesystem.read
description: Descriptor-relative, no-symlink read under an explicitly configured root.

name: filesystem.write
description: Descriptor-relative, no-symlink write under an explicitly configured root.

name: notifications.send
description: Send a desktop notification through the Notifications D-Bus interface.

name: network.status
description: Read NetworkManager connectivity and state; no privileged reconfiguration.

name: systemd.user.status
description: Inspect a named user service through systemd D-Bus.

name: blender.status
description: Connection and host version.

name: blender.scene.inspect
description: Inspect scene objects, collections, materials and render settings.

name: blender.object.list
description: List native objects without scraping the GUI.

name: blender.object.get
description: Read one object by exact name.

name: blender.object.create
description: Create an allowlisted primitive.

name: blender.object.delete
description: Delete an exact named object.

name: blender.object.transform
description: Set absolute object transforms.

name: blender.collection.list
description: List collections.

name: blender.collection.create
description: Create a collection; conflicting names fail.

name: blender.collection.link
description: Link an object into an existing collection.

name: blender.material.list
description: List materials.

name: blender.material.create
description: Create a Principled material with typed color/roughness.

name: blender.material.assign
description: Assign one existing material to an exact object.

name: blender.render.settings
description: Set bounded resolution and sample settings.

name: blender.render
description: Render to a path below the owner-configured Blender workspace.

name: blender.file.save
description: Save the current scene under the owner-configured workspace.

name: blender.file.open
description: Open an existing .blend with automatic Python execution disabled.

name: browser.status
description: Inspect the project-owned Chromium instance.

name: browser.launch
description: Launch an isolated Chromium profile; no attachment to normal profiles.

name: browser.tab.list
description: List targets in the isolated browser.

name: browser.tab.open
description: Create an isolated browser tab.

name: browser.tab.close
description: Close one exact browser tab.

name: browser.tab.focus
description: Activate a browser tab.

name: browser.navigate
description: Navigate a tab to an http(s) URL; file URLs are denied.

name: browser.dom.snapshot
description: Get a bounded DOM tree without evaluating arbitrary JavaScript.

name: browser.dom.query
description: Query DOM nodes using a CSS selector; return candidates, not an implicit click.

name: browser.dom.click
description: Click one exact DOM reference after document-generation validation.

name: browser.dom.fill
description: Replace a text field using DOM focus and typed CDP input.

name: browser.screenshot
description: Capture an isolated tab into a private artifact.

name: browser.downloads.status
description: Inspect tracked download events for the isolated browser.

name: browser.diagnostics
description: Return bounded event counts, not network headers or console payloads.

name: plugin.install
description: Install a digest-pinned manifest into this broker session after external approval

name: plugin.remove
description: Remove a plugin and its registered commands from this broker

name: plugin.doctor
description: Validate a plugin manifest, digest and sandbox prerequisites

name: capabilities.search
description: Search the bounded capability catalog by exact ID, words, quoted phrases, provider, app, risk, category, tags, object types and current operation availability. Results include provenance, not blanket permission.

name: capabilities.describe
description: Describe one capability with full input/output schema, source digest, provenance and operation-specific routes. Availability never grants authorization.

name: jobs.start
description: Start a bounded session-scoped job; the nested command is independently authorized and audited.

name: jobs.get
description: Read one job owned by this broker session without exposing jobs from other sessions.

name: jobs.cancel
description: Request cancellation of one job owned by this broker session; repeated cancellation is idempotent.
